# Does showing hazards and ground damage to the action model cut hazard damage?

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | hazards |
| Result | inconclusive |
| Created | L2.I5 |
| Updated | L2.I9 |

## Hypothesis

Putting standing_on, hazards and hurt_by in action.state, with a hurt prompt that names ground hazards, makes the action model avoid Brambles, Spore vents and burning oil, so ground damage falls without lowering kills.

## Method

Fresh seeker-sprouts on seed 32 with the opening knobs on, 300 s. Compare with L2.I4.G2 (same seed and knobs, Brambles 41.6, total 200). Read damage by hazard source, model-asked moves and total damage. Add seeds 33 and 31 next.

## Findings

Over five paired seeds the hazard prompt lived 5:00 on 3 of 5, the same as knobs alone. Hot oil, Brambles and Spore vent damage fell on seeds 32 and 35 but not consistently on 31, 33 and 34. Dashes rose to 7-23 per game with unclear benefit. No playbook change.
